--- a/docker-compose.yml
+++ b/docker-compose.yml
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@ services:
     environment:
-      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:app@db:5432/app
+      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+psycopg://app:app@db:5432/app
     depends_on:
-      - db
+      db:
+        condition: service_healthy
     healthcheck:
-      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8080/healthz"]
+      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:8080/healthz"]
output:
chore(docker): wait for a healthy database before app start

Adds a service_healthy dependency so the app no longer races the
postgres bootstrap, switches to the psycopg scheme, and uses
wget (curl is not in the slim image).

instruction:
Write a Conventional Commits message for this diff:

diff --git a/scripts/backup.sh b/scripts/backup.sh
--- a/scripts/backup.sh
+++ b/scripts/backup.sh
@@ -1,8 +1,10 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
 set -euo pipefail
 
+STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
 OUT_DIR=${OUT_DIR:-/var/backups/app}
-mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
+mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
 
-pg_dump "$DATABASE_URL" > "$OUT_DIR/latest.sql"
+pg_dump "$DATABASE_URL" | gzip > "$OUT_DIR/app-$STAMP.sql.gz"
+ln -sf "$OUT_DIR/app-$STAMP.sql.gz" "$OUT_DIR/latest.sql.gz"
+find "$OUT_DIR" -name 'app-*.sql.gz' -mtime +14 -delete
output:
chore(backup): timestamp, compress, and rotate dump files

Dumps are gzipped with a timestamp, `latest` is a symlink, and
dumps older than 14 days are pruned so the disk cannot fill.
